items.title: United Airlines (UAL) Stock May Be About Right After Oil Price Relief
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings has ridden a powerful recovery story, with the share price moving sharply over recent years while ticket prices and fuel costs keep grabbing headlines. With that backdrop, the live question is whether the current valuation really lines up with the cash that United can generate over time.
